dedupe_keys.name: climate data for building simulations with urban heat island effects and nature based solutions

description: Climate data for building simulations with urban heat island effects and nature-based solutions is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Henry Lu et al. As cities face a changing climate, buildings will be subjected to increasing energy demand, heat stress, thermal comfort issues, and decreased service life. Therefore, evaluating building performance under climate change supports sustainable and resilient communities. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2024. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
